decisive_items: basophilic cells and shadow cells in the deep dermis
chalky-white cut surface and lobulated appearance
response.rationale: R3 is strongly supported by multiple pathognomonic raw spans (basophilic cells, shadow cells, chalky-white cut surface, hard nodule) that uniquely identify pilomatrixoma. R1 only cites multilocular spaces and dilated lymphatic vessels, which are non-specific and do not exclude pilomatrixoma. C1 is a redundant append-only completion of R3 and adds no independent evidence.

rejected.why: Append-only completion of R3 with no independent raw support; redundant and not a distinct diagnosis.
Lacks the definitive basophilic/shadow cells and chalky-white cut surface; features cited are non-specific and consistent with pilomatrixoma.
